title: 并行LLM推理实现抗偏稳健的概念抽象
summary: 提出一种结构化框架，通过并行分块处理与基于证据的整合，解决长文档分析中的累积偏差、遗漏错误和过度泛化问题。实验表明，该方法将遗漏错误减少约84%，证据可追溯性提升高达130%，无依据声明减少高达91%，尤其对小模型效果显著。
summary_en: Proposes a structured framework combining parallel chunk-level processing with evidence-anchored consolidation to address cumulative bias, omission errors, and over-generalization in long document analysis. Experiments show ~84% reduction in omission errors, up to 130% increase in evidence traceability, and up to 91% reduction in unsupported claims, with smaller models benefiting most.
